message.content:
**Answer**

The SNP rs7412 is located in the *APOE* gene and defines the ε2 allele when the C allele is present at position 112 (the other allele at position 158 is T). In European ancestry populations, the minor allele frequency (MAF) for rs7412 (C allele) is typically reported as **≈ 0.12–0.15** (i.e., 12–15 % of chromosomes carry the C allele).  

| Population group | MAF (C allele) |
|------------------|----------------|
| Non‑Hispanic White (US) | ~0.13 |
| European (EUR) in 1000 Genomes | ~0.14 |
| British (UK Biobank) | ~0.12 |

These values come from large population studies such as the 1000 Genomes Project and UK Biobank. Frequencies can differ slightly among sub‑European groups (e.g., higher in Southern Europeans, lower in Northern Europeans), but the overall range remains roughly 12–15 %.
